claims.claim: The application requires details of the event and its type.
claims.quote: Name and nature of the performances or activities in respect of which the licence is requested (for example, theatrical, filming, sport, modelling), and a description of what the child will be required to do as a result of taking part in the performances or activities.
claims.note: The regulations require the name and nature of the performances or activities and a description of the child’s part.
